title: Reality Fracture
description: Mastermind mage Jace Beleren has pushed reality to its breaking point. An alternate Multiverse of his own creation threatens to overtake the current one, and just one brave team of heroes stands in the path of oblivion. Be on the lookout for twisted new reflections of Magic legends as you explore Jace's Echoverse and his inner sanctum within the dystopian school of Hexhaven.
shortDescription: Be among the first to experience Magic: The Gathering® | Reality Fracture at Kitsune Brewing Co. Explore new cards, build your sealed deck, and play the set before its official release.
location: Kitsune Brewing Co. — 3321 E Bell Rd Suite B-5, Phoenix, AZ 85032
